WITH ordered_cities AS (
    SELECT 
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_state,
        LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (
            ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
        ) AS prev_lat,
        LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (
            ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
        ) AS prev_lng,
        LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (
            ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
        ) AS prev_city,
        LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (
            ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
        ) AS prev_state
    FROM olist_geolocation
),
valid_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        geolocation_city AS city2,
        geolocation_state AS state2,
        prev_city AS city1,
        prev_state AS state1,
        geolocation_lat AS lat2,
        geolocation_lng AS lng2,
        prev_lat AS lat1,
        prev_lng AS lng1
    FROM ordered_cities
    WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL 
      AND prev_lng IS NOT NULL
),
distances AS (
    SELECT 
        city2,
        state2,
        city1,
        state1,
        lat2,
        lng2,
        lat1,
        lng1,
        6371 * ACOS(
            GREATEST(LEAST(
                COS(RADIANS(lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(lat2)) * COS(RADIANS(lng2) - RADIANS(lng1)) + 
                SIN(RADIANS(lat1)) * SIN(RADIANS(lat2)),
                1.0
            ), -1.0)
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM valid_pairs
)
SELECT city2, state2, city1, state1, distance_km
FROM distances
WHERE distance_km = (SELECT MAX(distance_km) FROM distances)
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
